title: The File That Can Change Everything
subtitle: Dr. Karim & Dr. Nadia are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 🏥

Dr. Karim and Dr. Nadia are two passionate dentists. Every day, they treat their patients with dedication.

But a major challenge awaits them: mastering Law 65-00 on Compulsory Health Insurance.

Between ANAM, CNSS, national agreements, nomenclatures, exemptions, and sanctions... the path is full of obstacles.

Their patients rely on them for optimal coverage.
Their practice depends on well-managed reimbursements.

chapters.debutant1: Welcome, Doctor! Dr. Karim and Dr. Nadia are two passionate dentists. Every day, they treat their patients with dedication. But a major challenge awaits them: mastering the basics of Law 65-00 on Compulsory Health Insurance. They discover the foundations of AMO, the roles of ANAM and CNSS, and the principles of risk pooling and national solidarity.
chapters.debutant2: Dr. Karim and Dr. Nadia deepen their knowledge of the legal aspects of AMO. They study the articles of Law 65-00, the rights of dependents, covered benefits, and the penalties incurred for non-compliance with legal obligations.
chapters.intermediaire1: Dr. Karim and Dr. Nadia face complex practical cases: ALD patients, third-party payer files, and ticket modérateur exemptions. They must master the management of agreement files to optimize their patients' reimbursements.
chapters.intermediaire2: Dr. Karim and Dr. Nadia must manage disputes with CNSS. Refusal of coverage, ANAM audits, agreement disputes... They must defend their files and know the available appeals.
chapters.expert1: Dr. Karim and Dr. Nadia become agreement experts. They train young dentists in AMO file management, participate in agreement negotiations, and contribute to innovation in the healthcare system.
chapters.expert2: After years of practice and commitment, Dr. Karim and Dr. Nadia pass on their knowledge. They leave a legacy of rigor, transparency, and public service to the dental profession. The agreement is the soul of social security.

chapterEndings.debutant1: Dr. Karim and Dr. Nadia have laid the foundations of the agreement. But the road is still long...
chapterEndings.debutant2: The legal aspects are mastered. Dr. Karim and Dr. Nadia are ready to manage complex files.
chapterEndings.intermediaire1: Complex files are successfully managed. Dr. Karim and Dr. Nadia have gained confidence.
chapterEndings.intermediaire2: Disputes are under control. Dr. Karim and Dr. Nadia are ready for greater challenges.
chapterEndings.expert1: The agreement has become a key skill. Dr. Karim and Dr. Nadia train young dentists.
chapterEndings.expert2: Dr. Karim and Dr. Nadia have accomplished their mission. The agreement is the soul of social security.
